svg.aria-label: A ticket is ready when its project is Started, its spec state is Backlog, Specify or Specced, and every ticket in its chain of blockers is Completed. A blocker that is still in progress or Canceled keeps a ticket out. Ready tickets are ordered by project priority, project order, ticket priority, ticket order, then identifier.
